about_the_game:
Knock on the Occult Door: Demo

Welcome to your first appointment.

In this free demo, you play through the opening client session of Knock on the Occult Door, a gothic visual novel where every meeting is a ritual.

You are a ritual specialist, visited by a troubled spouse whose guilt may be hiding something darker. Your role is to read their energy, select your protective accessory, and perform one of several occult bindings to decide their fate.

Will you offer them release… or bind them tighter to their own sins?

This demo includes:

  • The complete first client scene (“The Betrayer Spouse”)

  • Choice-based dialogue with multiple binding outcomes

  • Accessory selection that changes responses and risks

  • Atmospheric voice acting, gothic visuals, and ritual effects

  • A taste of the moral weight and occult mechanics of the full game

Step into the ritual space. Watch the mirror. And remember, even your first client may not be safe.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains themes and imagery intended for a mature audience. It includes:

  Dark psychological content involving trauma, guilt, and moral dilemmas
  Depictions of death, grief, and spiritual possession
  References to past violence and implied emotional or physical abuse
  Occult rituals and supernatural entities
  Mild horror elements including unsettling imagery and disturbing atmosphere

While there is no explicit sexual content, some narrative branches may touch on manipulation, betrayal, or obsession in relationships. Player discretion is advised.

Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04
  • Processor: Dual core from Intel or AMD at 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GeForce 8600/9600GT, ATI/AMD Radeon HD2600/3600 (Graphic Drivers: nVidia 310, AMD 12.11), OpenGL 2.1
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card

short_description: Bind spirits. Weigh their pain. Each client arrives by appointment haunted, broken, or dangerous. In this gothic occult visual novel, you use protective accessories, read signs, and choose bindings that alter fate. Some seek redemption. Others hide darker truths. Your rituals may awaken the dead.
